verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents sandboxed agent execution: an Apptainer sandbox guide, Docker and VM backends, and managed sandbox infrastructure in OpenHands Cloud. This is sandbox isolation rather than a dry-run mode. However, the evidence never states how these sandboxes keep agents away from production data or systems. missing for 10: explicit documentation of isolation guarantees from production data/credentials, details of sandbox configuration and network/filesystem boundaries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: OpenHands Cloud is the managed commercial service for running OpenHands without operating your own backend and sandbox infrastructure.
Apptainer (formerly Singularity) is a container runtime designed for HPC environments that doesn't require root access
Run agents locally, in Docker, on VMs, or anywhere you can run an agent server backend
